# Outbox CI command-profile diagnosis

Source snapshot: main c4d7109cfc4f9b72832fed21aa203f84eebdee9b and merge-group da41e5d77a60c8edb60528e72e5f663f076abca3. Both fetched script and shared Lua files are byte-identical across these snapshots. This is a diagnostic, not a product repair, approval, or native Redis reproduction.

## Observed failure

Run 42723259767, job 129522790103, failed on 2026-11-09 at 23:51:53 UTC. The exact assertion at scripts/test_order_confirmation_outbox_redis.py:183 expects enqueue 27/create 17/bound_replay 15/cursor 17/bind 18; only enqueue was 28. Later steps were skipped. Full decoded job log is retained.

The enqueue profile is captured at lines 79-80, BEFORE the 32 competing candidate operations. That race cannot directly contaminate this earlier measurement. The log configures Redis 7.4.12 in a service container with redis-cli ping every five seconds. The observer at lines 67-76 reads server-wide INFO COMMANDSTATS, runs the operation, then reads INFO again, without a transaction. It excludes all INFO commands but includes commands from other clients.

For the first healthy enqueue into absent global and store pools, the embedded `SHIPMENT_MAIL_SCRIPT` in [lib/shipment-mail-outbox.ts:191–276](https://github.com/solrenning-llc/marktmorgen/blob/c4d7109cfc4f9b72832fed21aa203f84eebdee9b/lib/shipment-mail-outbox.ts#L191-L276), blob `73a3085e0e845c17ddcfb01d28b3de2a3adf9f0f`, statically executes 26 redis.call commands plus EVAL = 27 (common reads at lines 197–213; fresh-pool enqueue path at lines 238–276): TYPE x10; GETRANGE x1; GET x1; EXISTS x1; HMGET x2; SCARD x2; ZCARD x1; HSET x2; SET x2; ZADD x1; SADD x3. This is a source trace, not a provider invoice.

## Deterministic causal model

The retained `observer-proof.py` extracts the exact unchanged stats/measured AST functions from the fetched outbox script and the exact measured_command AST from the existing contract script. It executes them against an explicitly synthetic command-counter/transaction model. Twelve checks pass. No Redis server, Lua interpreter, product module or provider runs.

- No noise: original observer gives 27.
- One outside PING between snapshots: original observer gives 28 while application EVAL remains unchanged; the unchanged exact 27 assertion rejects it.
- Existing atomic helper with the same outside noise: exactly 27, including EVAL.
- Internal application PING or INFO: remains counted, raises total to 28; no blanket noise filter.
- Two application commands: refused rather than hidden; no queued transaction left.

Single execution under 120s/512MiB/256KiB and a latched aggregate cap of 20,000 modeled dispatches: 23 dispatches, no cap hit. Raw output retained. No runtime replay, timeout increase, assertion relaxation or product edit. No Redis/valkey/docker binary was initially available. The subsequent native preparation and its blocked startup are recorded below; no native reproduction is claimed.

The SAME CI job independently passed scripts/test_contract_command_measurement.py at 23:51:30 UTC, including native external-PING isolation, internal PING/DBSIZE/INFO and 90 injected INFO boundaries for contract profiles. This is historical hosted evidence for that existing helper; it does not certify an adapted outbox integration.

## Recommendation to owner A3 / coordinator C1

Use the already-existing measured_command instrumentation for the reserved outbox script, retaining every exact expected profile and behavior assertion. The operation must queue exactly one application command: pre-read any expected GET outside that transaction, because the helper deliberately rejects two queued commands. Preserve EVAL and every internal Lua command, including INFO; do not simply accept 27 or 28, raise the ceiling, subtract every PING, add sleeps or rerun CI to hide the failure. Validate all measured caller paths with native Redis plus deterministic external PING before publishing one consolidated correction under the current coordination rules.

The specific external command that contaminated the failing hosted window is NOT captured by its aggregate-only output. Health PING is a supported causal hypothesis with a matching deterministic mechanism, not a retrospectively observed event. This is a test-observer defect; no financial/product regression or infrastructure-only classification is certified by this report. The native owner validation remains pending.

## Scope and accessibility

This PR publishes only this diagnostic report. The source snapshots, model, raw output and full job log remain in the previously delivered evidence package; no production or reserved test file is part of this PR. A3 owns scripts/test_order_confirmation_outbox_redis.py and the production outbox: unchanged. Workflows, customer limits, pricing, payment gates, accounts and provider configuration unchanged. No UI: task steps/decisions unchanged; no accessibility conformance claim. Compute/hosting cost is unknown, not zero. Original #3024 caps and local candidate remain untouched.

## Evidence and publication

- [Failed job](https://github.com/solrenning-llc/marktmorgen/actions/runs/42723259767/job/129522790103).
- [Exact outbox observer](https://github.com/solrenning-llc/marktmorgen/blob/c4d7109cfc4f9b72832fed21aa203f84eebdee9b/scripts/test_order_confirmation_outbox_redis.py#L67), blob `e30f71c0aec7ac45e1696ac676ea64cb6729c7b3`.
- [Existing atomic observer](https://github.com/solrenning-llc/marktmorgen/blob/c4d7109cfc4f9b72832fed21aa203f84eebdee9b/scripts/test_contract_funding_redis.py).
- [Native observer regression](https://github.com/solrenning-llc/marktmorgen/blob/c4d7109cfc4f9b72832fed21aa203f84eebdee9b/scripts/test_contract_command_measurement.py).
- [Previously delivered diagnostic package](https://github.com/solrenning-llc/repo-id-transfer-test/blob/3b944417febeb0456dfd4d63bd05ce63ce83211a/messages.md) (private coordination repository), section `CXV-20261109-2215-OUTBOX-EVID`: nine files, 236,476 decoded JSON bytes, SHA-256 `fc107b0236ec9f49206374ab7b32735a79f043ecfd588cf8d5f182352196c9dd`. The archive preserves original whitespace; readable views normalize whitespace only. This report is usable without executing that archive.

The 12 model checks and hosted log observations predate this documentation PR. They were not rerun to publish it. The ended TODOS-79 push pause is historical; TODOS-84 permits publication, subject to its queued-run check and three-new-PRs-per-hour limit. A3's file reservation and the need for native outbox validation remain. No production fix, CI retry, exact-head nine-check success or supplier cost certification is implied.

## Native preparation after TODOS-84

Redis 7.4.12 was subsequently cloned from the [official tagged source](https://github.com/redis/redis/tree/7.4.12), commit `f9bc2f89232fa3fc6147ee732309d2616117b85e`, and built in an isolated directory in 17.297 seconds (one compiler job, 120-second/512-MiB cap). A single native proof launch configured TCP port 0 and an owned Unix socket, with persistence disabled and a 64-MiB Redis data ceiling. The environment rejected Unix-socket creation with `Operation not permitted`. Redis exited before readiness, fixture setup, or any application command.

No socket or permission workaround, native retry, provider call, product execution, or model rerun followed. The native result is **blocked**, not pass or product failure; the aggregate proof ledger remains 23 modeled dispatches and zero native commands out of 20,000. The original build/startup/proof outputs are retained in the [native-attempt evidence](https://github.com/solrenning-llc/repo-id-transfer-test/blob/066760fae6c6de97ecc61efbd220e9fc506917df/evidence/v/outbox-native-attempt-20261110.json) (private coordination repository): five raw files, 29,410 decoded JSON bytes, SHA-256 `d67a665d1cd2d12cefa59a6cf2e2f49ff52b1686030040e9c1da84da36b9d782`. The exact 27-versus-28 assertion has not been relaxed. A3 still needs an admitted native environment to validate all adapted outbox callers.

## Same-pattern static inventory

A read-only search of Python integration scripts at main `18e061644cd454ac67ad5f2813e6dec0a4c0e9af` found these additional observer shapes. This inventory records instrumentation, not reproduced failures or permission to edit another owner's files. It did not run Redis, tests or product code.

| Script and source lines | Observed instrumentation | Follow-up limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `test_shipment_mail_outbox_redis.py:636-650` | Separate global snapshots; drops every INFO; total compared with a ceiling. | Same external-client contamination mechanism is possible; no actual failure established here. Recovery helpers at lines 48-53 and 438-444 already use MULTI/EXEC and subtract exactly one observer INFO. |
| `test_single_digital_confirmation_redis.py:52-57` | Separate global snapshots; drops every INFO; total ceiling 64. | Candidate for owner review; neither an overrun nor a financial regression is reproduced. |
| `test_order_confirmation_checkpoint_redis.py:51-60` | Separate global snapshots; drops every INFO; total ceiling 27. | Candidate for owner review; no hosted failure identified by this inventory. |
| `test_order_admission_redis.py:114-119` | Global total across three application operations; includes observer INFO and compares with a ceiling. | External activity can add to the interval; a single-command helper cannot be substituted without reviewing this multi-operation caller. |
| `test_capped_count_redis.py:161-165` | Separate global snapshots, but checks only six named hash-command deltas. | Outside PING is not included in those selected deltas. Do not classify this as the demonstrated PING-to-total failure. Other-client hash activity remains untested. |
| `test_resend_fallback_budget_redis.py:585-602` | Imports the existing atomic measured_command helper; exact profile assertions. | Existing isolated shape; no new defect claimed. |

This search supplies a bounded owner-review list. It is not evidence that every listed script fails, that every commandstats observer has been audited, or that the reserved outbox correction has been validated.
